policy_requirement: AI outputs must not expose personal data unless there is a valid purpose and review pathway
evidence_required: Prompt/output review record and privacy handling decision

policy_requirement: AI outputs involving sensitive data must be reviewed before use or publication
evidence_required: Human review record and data minimisation decision

policy_requirement: AI outputs must not disclose confidential internal information beyond authorised audiences
evidence_required: Access approval and internal-use classification evidence

policy_requirement: AI outputs should not present unsupported legal privacy security or compliance claims as fact
evidence_required: Fact-check record source validation and reviewer approval

policy_requirement: AI-generated security advice must be reviewed where it may influence implementation or operational decisions
evidence_required: Security reviewer approval and technical validation evidence

policy_requirement: AI outputs that conflict with privacy security or data governance policy must be rejected or corrected
evidence_required: Policy review decision corrected output and rejection reason

policy_requirement: High-risk AI outputs must be routed to a human reviewer before business use
evidence_required: Reviewer name decision timestamp and approval outcome

policy_requirement: AI evaluation results must be retained as evidence for governance review and continuous improvement
risk_trigger: Any high or critical AI risk
evidence_required: AI risk register executive summary and review notes
